_comment: Chord detection tuning and the chords that fire Home Assistant triggers.
Edit this file and re-flash: idf.py build flash
stable_ms         how long the set of held keys must stay unchanged before
it counts as a chord. Raise it if rolled chords produce
min_notes         fewest keys held at once to consider a chord at all.
include_sustained count notes still ringing via the sustain pedal (CC64).
retrigger_ms      a trigger will not fire again within this window.
"chord": "C/E"      additionally requires E in the bass.
"notes": [60,64,67]  those exact MIDI note numbers, nothing else.
